catalogue_variant_missing: The catalogue variant of this configuration no longer exists.
coded_field_locked: The coded fields of a catalogue configuration come from the catalogue and cannot be changed.
coded_field_required: The coded fields of a manual configuration cannot be cleared.
coded_fields_required: A manual configuration needs all five coded fields.
configuration_mode_fixed: The mode of a saved configuration cannot be changed — copy it into a new configuration instead.
configuration_mode_not_allowed: A configuration of this kind cannot be used here.
invalid_new_price: A best match needs the new price.
invalid_type_approval_number: A best match needs the Typenschein.
no_catalogue_variant: A configuration without a catalogue variant cannot be re-synced.
no_fields: Choose at least one field to re-sync.
provider_code_already_mapped: This provider code is already mapped to {{mapping}}.
unknown_fields: Some of the chosen specification fields are unknown.
unrecognised_identifier: The input is not a VIN, a licence plate, a Stammnummer, a Typenschein or a Werkscode.
brand_code_taken: A brand with this code already exists.
plate_already_on_vehicle: This plate is already recorded on this vehicle for that period.
plate_canton_invalid: Please choose one of the 26 cantons.
plate_current_on_other_vehicle: This plate is recorded on another vehicle.
plate_invalid: A plate is the canton and one to six digits, e.g. ZH 123456.
plate_move_and_wechselschild: A plate either moves or becomes an interchangeable plate, not both.
plate_move_before_start: The assignment on the other vehicle starts on the same day or later – please choose a later «Valid from».
plate_validity_invalid: An assignment cannot end before it starts.
plate_wechselschild_not_possible: An interchangeable plate joins exactly two vehicles – this plate is already on two.
catalogue_filter_value_unknown: The provider does not know this filter value.
catalogue_scope_required: Choose a brand or a model group first — the catalogue is never queried whole.
sort_field_unknown: The catalogue cannot be sorted by this field.
vehicle_kind_unknown_to_provider: The provider does not know this vehicle kind.
catalogue_scope_invalid: The brand or model group is not a valid name.
vin_belongs_to_other_vehicle: This VIN already belongs to vehicle {{vehicleNumber}} in the vehicle records. If it is the same car, merge the two there with «Merge into…».
vin_names_merged_vehicle: This VIN belongs to a vehicle record that was merged into {{vehicleNumber}}. The vehicle carries the VIN {{vin}}.
vehicle_vin_changed: The VIN in the vehicle record has changed meanwhile. Please reload and try again.
vin_change_needs_vin_correction: This vehicle is in your business's stock as {{stockNumber}}. Its VIN is changed there with “Correct VIN”, so the stock vehicle, the vehicle record and the configuration carry the same VIN.
chassis_number_identity_fixed: This vehicle is identified by its chassis number. It is corrected only on the stock vehicle with “Correct VIN”, so the stock vehicle, the vehicle record and the configuration carry the same number.
chassis_number_requires_make: A vehicle with a chassis number is told apart by its make: enter the make in its configuration.
vehicle_merge_same_record: A record cannot be merged with itself.
vehicle_merge_both_in_stock: Your business holds both records in stock ({{duplicate}} and {{survivor}}). Sell or cancel one of the stock cars first.
vehicle_merge_vin_into_chassis_number: A record with a VIN cannot be merged into one with a pre-1981 chassis number. «Swap direction» keeps the VIN record.
